messages.author: a2bfdf24157fa01a
messages.subject: New paper using Stan
parts:
Hi all,

One more paper using Stan: http://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/gcb.13719/full

For Bibtex:

@article {GCB:GCB13719,
  author = {Espe, Matthew B. and Hill, Jim E. and Hijmans,
                  Robert J. and McKenzie, Kent and Mutters, Randall
                  and Espino, Luis A. and Leinfelder-Miles, Michelle
                  and van Kessel, Chris and Linquist, Bruce A.},
  title = {Point stresses during reproductive stage rather than
                  warming seasonal temperature determines yield in
                  temperate rice},
  journal = {Global Change Biology},
  issn = {1365-2486},
  url = {http://dx.doi.org/10.1111/gcb.13719},
  doi = {10.1111/gcb.13719},
  pages = {n/a--n/a},
  keywords = {rice, yield potential, temperature, cold sterility,
                  respiration, climate change},
}

here:

just plain old citations are fine! As are pull requests
to stan-dev/stan-dev.github.io !
